title: Cart total ignores discount
hints: Add a console.log of the coupon inside calculateDiscount and run the tests.
Which branch of calculateDiscount does a SAVE10 coupon reach?
Compare how a percent coupon is defined in src/coupons with how src/discount checks for it.

hiddenTestRules.coupons > rounds the percent discount on: Percent coupons take that percent off the whole cart, rounded to the nearest cent.
hiddenTestRules.coupons > rounds percent discounts to th: Percent coupons take that percent off the whole cart, rounded to the nearest cent.
hiddenTestRules.coupons > accepts codes typed in lower c: Codes ignore upper/lower case and spaces around them
hiddenTestRules.coupons > regression: a fixed coupon nev: Fixed coupons take that many cents off, but the total never goes below 0.
